products.name: uv
products.description: A fast Python package and project manager combining installation, environments, Python versions and project workflows.
products.differentiator: Unifies several Python development workflows in one Rust-based tool.
limitations: The repository documents capabilities but does not prove every developer experiences this pain.
No verified adoption or willingness-to-pay conclusion is made.
Not a newly launched product on the observation date.

en.who: Imagine a Python developer switching tools just to install dependencies, select a Python version and run a project.
en.pain: Every handoff adds setup steps and things to remember.
en.solution: uv combines these everyday jobs in one fast tool.
en.benefit: Project setup might feel simpler and faster.
en.uncertainty: Which workflows does it actually replace for different teams?

zh.who: 想象你正在开始一个 Python 项目：装依赖、切版本、建环境，需要切换好几套工具。
zh.pain: 每一步都要记不同命令，新人更容易在环境配置上卡住。
zh.solution: uv 尝试把这些常见操作放进一个速度很快的工具。
zh.benefit: 可能让项目启动和维护更顺手。
zh.uncertainty: 对不同规模的团队，它实际替代了哪些工作流？

fr.who: Imaginez devoir jongler entre plusieurs outils pour installer des dépendances et gérer Python.
fr.pain: Chaque changement ajoute des étapes de configuration.
fr.solution: uv rassemble ces tâches dans un outil rapide.
fr.benefit: La mise en place d'un projet pourrait devenir plus simple.
fr.uncertainty: Quels usages remplace-t-il réellement selon les équipes ?

products.name: Memos
products.description: An open-source self-hosted notebook built around quick thoughts and a personal timeline.
products.differentiator: Treats quick notes as a personal timeline rather than a heavyweight document workspace.
limitations: The project describes its own positioning; this is not independent user research.
No validated market-size, payment or retention evidence here.
This is a cataloged existing product, not a verified new launch.

en.who: Imagine remembering an interesting thought but not wanting to organize a full document.
en.pain: A complex notes workspace can create friction for a tiny idea.
en.solution: Memos makes short entries part of a personal chronological stream.
en.benefit: Capturing fleeting thoughts may feel lightweight.
en.uncertainty: Will a timeline remain usable when notes accumulate?

zh.who: 想象你突然想到一句值得记下来的话，却不想为了它建一个文档、选目录、整理标签。
zh.pain: 有时记录一个小想法，工具本身反而太复杂。
zh.solution: Memos 把简短笔记放在自己的时间线上，像记录日常动态一样写下来。
zh.benefit: 捕捉稍纵即逝的想法可能更轻松。
zh.uncertainty: 时间线变长后，检索和整理是否依然方便？

fr.who: Imaginez une idée à noter sans vouloir créer un document entier.
fr.pain: Organiser un espace de notes peut être disproportionné pour une phrase.
fr.solution: Memos place les petites notes dans une chronologie personnelle.
fr.benefit: Noter les idées spontanées pourrait être plus facile.
fr.uncertainty: La chronologie reste-t-elle pratique après des centaines de notes ?

products.name: Immich
products.description: Self-hosted photo and video management with mobile backup, albums, search and sharing.
products.differentiator: Offers a self-hosted alternative for managing personal photo and video libraries.
limitations: Self-hosting requires maintenance and backups; the project specifically warns about robust backups.
Product features are confirmed by its repository; general market demand is not established.
This is an established product, not a launch from 2026-11-03.

en.who: Imagine years of family photos spread across devices and cloud services.
en.pain: You want search, sharing and backups, but also control over storage.
en.solution: Immich offers a photo library you can run on your own server.
en.benefit: It may give technically comfortable households more control.
en.uncertainty: Are maintenance and backup responsibilities worth the trade-off?

zh.who: 想象手机和电脑里有很多年的照片，既想随时搜索和分享，又想自己掌握数据。
zh.pain: 方便的云服务和自己控制照片存储之间，往往需要取舍。
zh.solution: Immich 提供可以部署在自己服务器上的照片管理、备份与搜索体验。
zh.benefit: 对愿意自己维护服务的人来说，可能更有掌控感。
zh.uncertainty: 维护成本和可靠备份是否会让普通用户望而却步？

fr.who: Imaginez des années de photos réparties entre appareils et services cloud.
fr.pain: Vous souhaitez sauvegarder et partager sans perdre la maîtrise du stockage.
fr.solution: Immich propose une photothèque hébergée sur votre propre serveur.
fr.benefit: Cela pourrait offrir davantage de contrôle.
fr.uncertainty: La maintenance et les sauvegardes compensent-elles cet avantage ?

warning: Observed-at is the research observation date, not necessarily the launch date. Product listing does not prove demand or product-market fit.
